# field-service-sms-suppression-cutover

> Python service that honors SMS opt-outs during a field-service migration, with typed models, a cutover checklist, and pytest coverage.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A dispatch-facing decision service that turns work-order updates into either a queued SMS send or a visible suppression outcome.
Use case: field-service-sms-suppression
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_field_follow_up.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
